title: Deer in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <rect x='58' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <rect x='43' y='84' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#d98a3a'/>
  <rect x='51' y='84' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#d98a3a'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M32 60 Q50 52 68 60 L68 66 Q50 58 32 66 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M62 64 L70 78 L62 80 L58 66 Z' fill='#e63e5c'/>
  <path d='M34 62 Q50 55 66 62' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- neck/head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#c9722a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='34' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#c9722a' transform='rotate(-30 30 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='34' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#c9722a' transform='rotate(30 70 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='34' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#ffb3c1' transform='rotate(-30 30 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='34' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#ffb3c1' transform='rotate(30 70 34)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M43 32 L38 18 L33 22 M38 22 L34 14' stroke='#e8b06a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M57 32 L62 18 L67 22 M62 22 L66 14' stroke='#e8b06a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='41.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='41.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5a3a20'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='49' r='2' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='49' r='2' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='68' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f0c090'/>
</svg>
